_comment: A PASSING decomposition (the corrected ADR-1244). Copy this shape. The id strings are yours to choose — D1..Dn for ADR decisions, and a readable id like 'UX-manage' for each user-facing capability the ADR PROMISES. Mark user_facing:true for anything the user directly invokes/sees (a command, route, screen). Every decision must be owned by exactly one phase; every defer must land in a phase that owns or accepts it; every user-facing capability must have an owning phase whose accepts names the wired surface.

phases.name: Versioned manifest
accepts: capability.json carries version + engines.gsd; CI stamps native versions

phases.name: Registry overlay
accepts: loadRegistry composes installed overlay over first-party

phases.name: Resolver + ledger
accepts: resolveCapabilitySource stages copy-only; ledger records installs

phases.name: Registry-driven dispatch
accepts: graphify/intel/audit dispatched via the registry seam

phases.name: Matrix + management command
accepts: user can run the `gsd capability install/update/remove/list` CLI command (wired to the Phase-4 lifecycle)
